## What's new

- **New app icon** with **light and dark** versions. iOS switches between them with the Home Screen appearance.
- **Status bar redesigned** to match console-style launchers: clock first, then controller, network and a battery icon. The battery percentage text is gone (VoiceOver still reads the level), so nothing wraps onto two lines anymore.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
